from fractions import Fraction
minor=[(h,(h+1)**(h+1),101**2*4**h) for h in range(1,8)]
assert all(a<b for h,a,b in minor)
divisors=list(range(2,math.isqrt(101)+1));assert all(101%q for q in divisors)
h=hashlib.sha256();count=0
for n in range(8,1025):
 A=6*2**(n-4)-n+3;T=(n**3-n)//6-1
 An=6*2**(n-3)-n+2;Tn=((n+1)**3-(n+1))//6-1
 assert A>T and An-2*A==n-4>0 and 2*T-Tn==n*(n+1)*(n-4)//6-1>0
 h.update(json.dumps([n,A,T,An-2*A,2*T-Tn],separators=(',',':')).encode()+b'\n');count+=1
print(json.dumps(dict(verified_integer_controls=True,minor_dimensions=minor,prime_trial_divisors=divisors,saturation_vs_cubic_controls=count,maximum_n=1024,semantic_sha256=h.hexdigest(),boundary='finite arithmetic controls of the elementary paper induction and prime/minor fact, NOT independent verification of the n7 native input cover or ALL-shortest search')))
